name: Jersey Jack Big Badass Strap
epitaph: Jersey Jack Grappling's own top championship, a fifty-pound steel strap, still waiting for a first titleholder when the held record ends.

name: Jersey Jack Big Beermug of Doom
epitaph: A secondary championship built as a steel beer mug on a wooden base, meant to be defended in periodic open tournaments, still unclaimed when the held record ends.

name: Jersey Jack Badass Tag Straps
epitaph: Jersey Jack Grappling's own tag team championship, still waiting for its first champions when the held record ends.
